note: Published rows in build/dataset/crosswalk_v1.0.jsonl whose control identity the corpus rebuild retires. Measured by differencing: a row counts here only if its section_id named a control in the pre-rebuild corpus and names none in the rebuilt one, so the frameworks that never joined by string equality are excluded rather than blamed on the rebuild. Every row carries review_status='ground_truth'. tract/export/canonical.py filters on review_status='accepted', so diff_snapshots never sees them and no UPDATE_CONTROL or DELETE_CONTROL changeset will mention them. Republication is banned here, so this file is the record until that ban lifts. id_lineage says how recoverable each row is: prefix_only means the identifier survives verbatim once the redundant framework prefix is dropped, id_reshaped means it survives under a folded case or separator, gone means the control has no successor identifier at all.
